issue_request: FHIR-28292 asked whether a single output parameter named return may be wrapped in Parameters, because operations.html#executing said MAY while operations.html#response said the response is simply the resource. The Published/Persuasive decision was to require direct return when the return output has maximum cardinality 1 and a resource type.
initial_application: Git commit 61cdda43d3 applied the issue by changing the overview sentence to SHALL with no wrapping Parameters resource, removing the duplicate MAY paragraph, and updating the response section to refer to one single Resource named return.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2020-12-07 record the same 11-0-0 decision. source/hierarchy.xml includes operations.html as a current build page. Operation-specific notes for multi-cardinality return Bundles still say those responses use Parameters, which is consistent with the max-cardinality-1 limit. A companion AutoFHIR FHIR-24869 commit fixed an adjacent one-letter typo in the same paragraph before this audit.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/operations.html already contains the required SHALL/no-wrapping rule and the response section already says the parameter format is not used for one single Resource named return.
